recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-38937; any future Citation filtering changes should be considered in the artifact that currently owns Citation-related EBM guidance rather than as an R6 core patch for this R5 tracker.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification CDS issue requesting better filtering of Citation by category or code; the accepted resolution uses Citation.classification with type and classifier and adds search parameters for type/value rather than adding a prescriptive category element.
initial_application: Commit 5925247efc9f5a98fb4609b281131c49b47e00da explicitly applied J#38937 by adding Citation-classifier, Citation-classification-type, and composite Citation-classification search parameters to source/citation/bundle-Citation-search-params.xml. The R5 published Citation search page includes those parameters.
additional_context: The current core branch intentionally removed Citation in commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36; source/fhir.ini has no active Citation resource and source/citation is absent. Current MetadataResource narrative links Citation out to the EBM IG, and Confluence CDS archive evidence corroborates the February 2023 application as adding search parameters for Citation.classification.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Reintroducing or editing Citation search parameters in current core would be out of build scope because there is no current core Citation resource source to edit.
